# AnyCaptions

> AnyCaptions is a free Windows desktop app that shows real-time captions for any audio playing on the computer — games, videos, calls and streams — with on-device AI. It can also translate the captions and type dictated speech into any app. All speech recognition and translation run locally: no audio or text ever leaves the machine.

AnyCaptions é um aplicativo gratuito para Windows que mostra legendas em tempo real de qualquer áudio do computador (jogos, vídeos, chamadas), com reconhecimento de voz e tradução rodando 100% localmente — nenhum áudio ou texto sai da máquina.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 11 x64 (desktop app, Tauri + Rust)
- Price: free; account (Google, GitHub or Discord) required only to download
- Speech recognition: NVIDIA Nemotron streaming ASR, on device (Vulkan GPU or CPU)
- Translation: local models (OPUS-MT, Riva Translate), dozens of target languages
- Dictation: push-to-talk speech-to-text pasted into the focused app, with optional translation
- Privacy: audio and captions stay in memory only — no history, no logs, no cloud
- Overlay: transparent, click-through caption window that works over games and videos
